lines.text: چهرهردوكوكب دراين برج برحال محموداند واكرزحل مستعلي باشد صلاح حال مردم
lines.en: since both planets in this sign are in a praiseworthy state. And if Saturn is dominant, it indicates the good condition of the people

lines.text: بود وبسياري حشرات الارض واكرزهره مستعلي بود اختلاف ميان دو پادشاه
lines.en: and an abundance of insects of the earth. And if Venus is dominant, it indicates a dispute between two kings

lines.text: ظاهر شود وتوسط حال كشتيها بود (واكر در دلو بود) دلالت كند برغلبه نشاط
lines.en: will appear, and the condition of ships will be moderate. (And if it is in Aquarius), it indicates the prevalence of joy

lines.text: در پيران وكشاورزان وتماشا وسور در رستاق وكوه پايهها ونكاحهاي بي رغبت
lines.en: among the elderly and farmers, and spectacles and feasts in the countryside and foothills, and marriages without desire,

lines.text: وشدت سرما وكثرت موت زنان وبدحال مطربان ووقوع سعالات ونزلات و
lines.en: and the severity of cold, and the abundance of death among women, and the bad condition of musicians, and the occurrence of coughs and catarrhs, and

lines.text: قوة حال پيران وضعف جوانان وزنان وكودكان اكرزحل مستعلي بود دلالت كند بر
lines.en: the strength of the condition of the elderly and the weakness of youths, women, and children. If Saturn is dominant, it indicates

lines.text: علتهاي مردم بيشتر ازسعال وبسياري باران (مقارنه زهره وزحل درمثلثه ابي) دلالت
lines.en: the illnesses of people, mostly from coughs, and an abundance of rain. (The conjunction of Venus and Saturn in the watery triplicity) indicates

lines.text: كند برغلبه ابها وقوت سرما وشكستن كرما دروقت وزيان ميوها ونباتات وبيماري
lines.en: the prevalence of waters, and the strength of cold, and the breaking of heat in its time, and harm to fruits and plants, and illness

lines.text: از برودت وخراب شدن مواضع از كثرت اب وبسياري كشت وزرع وفراخي اطعمه و
lines.en: from cold, and the ruin of places from the abundance of water, and an abundance of crops and agriculture, and the plentifulness of foods, and

lines.text: ظهور علت در زنان ودختران ونشاط در پيران وتوبه اهل ملاهي وفساد حال زنا
lines.en: the appearance of illness in women and girls, and joy in the elderly, and the repentance of the people of amusement, and the corruption of the condition of fornicators,

lines.text: زايند وميل مردم بسفر دريا وحركت دزدان ودرامد بشهرها وبدي حال شهريان وحصاريان
lines.en: and women giving birth, and the inclination of people to sea travel, and the movement of thieves and their entry into cities, and the bad condition of city dwellers and those in fortresses,

lines.text: واهل جبال* (واكر در برج سرطان بود) دلالت كند برخلاصي محبوسان وسفرهاي
lines.en: and the people of the mountains. (And if it is in the sign of Cancer), it indicates the release of prisoners, and travels

lines.text: دريا واندوه خواتين وخدم واهل طرب وغلبه ابها وقوت سرما وضعف كرما
lines.en: by sea, and sorrow for ladies and servants and the people of joy, and the prevalence of waters, and the strength of cold, and the weakness of heat

lines.text: دروقت وكثرت موت در ديار فرنك وبسياري قحط ومرض خلايق سيما در زنان
lines.en: in its time, and the abundance of death in the lands of the Franks, and an abundance of famine and disease among the creatures, especially in women,

lines.text: وسوء حال مطربان وخواتين وزيادتي نمودن ابر وباران اكرزحل مستعلي بود دلالت
lines.en: and the bad condition of musicians and ladies, and the increase of clouds and rain. If Saturn is dominant, it indicates

lines.text: كند بركثرت موت در بلاد روم وبسياري ملخ اكرزهره مستعلي بود بارانهاي متواتر
lines.en: an abundance of death in the lands of Rome, and an abundance of locusts. If Venus is dominant, continuous rains

lines.text: بود وفساد كشت وزرع از بسياري ملخ (واكر در عقرب بود) دلالت كند برفساد
lines.en: will occur, and the corruption of crops and agriculture from the abundance of locusts. (And if it is in Scorpio), it indicates the corruption

lines.text: حال زنان بدكاره وكثرت هموم واحزان وشدت احوال مردمان ورعد وبرق و
lines.en: of the condition of wicked women, and the abundance of griefs and sorrows, and the severity of the conditions of people, and thunder and lightning, and

lines.text: باران وافت زنان زايند وكرفتاري فساق واندوه ارباب رود وسرود وخنكي
lines.en: rain, and calamity for women giving birth, and the capture of the immoral, and sorrow for the masters of the lute and song, and the coolness

lines.text: هوا وخرابي سواحل وتلف شدن زرعها وابرهاي غليظ پس اكرزحل مستعلي بود
lines.en: the air, and the ruin of coasts, and the destruction of crops, and thick clouds. Then if Saturn is elevated, it

lines.text: دلالت كند برحدوث امراض در ميان مردم وسختيها وبسياري باران واكرزهره
lines.en: indicates the occurrence of diseases among the people, and hardships, and an abundance of rain. And if Venus

lines.text: مستعلي بود دلالت كند برمصيبت پادشاه بابل ومرك زنان وتري هوا (واكر
lines.en: is dominant, it indicates a calamity for the king of Babylon, and the death of women, and the moisture of the air. (And if

lines.text: در حوت بود) دلالت كند برزحمت خواتين وتوبه اهل طرب ومرك فجاه در زنان
lines.en: it is in Pisces), it indicates trouble for ladies, and the repentance of the people of joy, and sudden death among women

summary.headline: Venus and Saturn in Watery Signs
summary.text: Astrological prognostications for the conjunction of Venus and Saturn in the watery triplicity, with separate effects in Aquarius, Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces. Predictions concern rain, cold, waters, crops, disease, deaths, childbirth, travel, social conditions, and named regions including the lands of the Franks, Rome, and Babylon.
